verdict.rationale: SavvyCal documents a REST, JSON API with OAuth 2.0 and personal access tokens. It has concrete endpoints for scheduling links (update, duplicate), available time slots (GET /v1/links/{link_id}/slots) and bookings (list, create and cancel events), plus custom metadata passthrough and signed webhooks, which covers the core of embedding scheduling in your own product. Missing for 10: a documented endpoint for creating new scheduling links (event types), endpoints for writing availability rules or schedules rather than only reading slots, a documented reschedule endpoint, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the API's depth.
